title: malacothamnus marrubioides
intro: Malacothamnus marrubioides, commonly known as Pink or Pink-Flowering Malacothamnus, is a perennial shrub native to the Pacific coast of North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of Malacothamnus marrubioides include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, which help to reduce pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include rosmarinic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
